install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24; nvm alias default 24; nvm use 24; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@11.9.0 --activate; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; ./scripts/agents/install-postgres-17.sh'
start: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null; pnpm db agent up'
